tools.name: get_current_moon
tools.title: Get current moon
tools.description: Returns the current tropical moon sign, phase, and illumination percentage for the transiting Moon right now.

tools.name: get_my_moon_profile
tools.title: Get my moon profile
tools.description: Returns the signed-in Moonday Live user's stored profile: email, birthday, and natal moon sign (per the Honest Chart Doctrine, no birth time is collected).

tools.name: list_recent_cosmic_weather
tools.title: List recent cosmic weather
tools.description: Returns the most recent Sun/Moon transit ticks from the 3-Node Matrix cosmic_weather table, newest first. Includes tropical, sidereal, and draconic moon signs.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return. Defaults to 10.
